test_title: PYST 28: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north. E sits to the immediate right of D. F sits fourth to the left of D. Only one person sits between B and D. C sits to the immediate left of B. A sits second to the left of E.

Three of the following four are alike in a certain way based on the given arrangement and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
Given: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) E sits to the immediate right of D.

2) F sits fourth to the left of D.

3) A sits second to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/674b848aaf77b0d16c218b89819b5defb00ff87242854c538aac87270db1c460.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a22dedb5dbe7e4717eaa80f93621a71dfe49e1c699cca9c1a1193e4dc1fb24c.png] 

4) Only one person sits between B and D. 

5) C sits to the immediate left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e24f82e6ed97fd336e774bc15a34a853a679890fd848c568b6715370d6f1ab9d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07c58ca047a27e2a1bbf68220ab23865a59251cc409fcc16b6ed31682ae6bd9b.png] 

Thus, FE is the one that does NOT belong to that group.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
